decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The erection of a rear roof extension to the existing dwellinghouse and installation of one roof light to the front of the roof, as shown on drawing number 368 received 3 July 2006 as amended by 368A received 7 August 2006 (Amended plan) would not harm the appearance of the existing building and street scene or the amenity of neighbouring properties and would preserve the appearance and character of Thorney Hedge Conservation Area. Therefore the proposed development is consistent with the relevant London Borough of Hounslow Unitary Development Plan 2003 policies; ENV-B.1.1 New Development, ENV-B.2.2 Conservation Areas, and H.6.4 Extensions and Alterations and the Supplementary Planning Guidance.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 5 - The roof light hereby permitted shall be of a conservation style and installed flush with the plane of the roof.
description: Erection of a rear roof extension with roof windows to front elevation of house
